defaults.permitted_development: A wraparound extension can be permitted development in Wales only if every rear and side element separately complies with the relevant Class A limits.

rules.height_rules: Single-storey elements should not exceed 4m in height. Eaves near a boundary should stay within the applicable 3m limit, and any part within 2m of a boundary should not exceed 4m in height.
rules.depth_rules: Each element must comply with the relevant rear and side extension limits. A single-storey rear element should not project more than 4m beyond the relevant rear wall.
rules.boundary_rules: The combined extension must stay behind the principal elevation and within the normal width, boundary and curtilage limits. A wraparound design cannot rely on one element breaching another element's limit.
rules.roof_rules: Where any part has more than one storey, the roof pitch should, as far as practicable, match the existing dwellinghouse. Roof terraces and balconies are not permitted development.
rules.materials_rules: External wall and roof materials should, as far as practicable, match the existing house.

rules.boundary_rules: The combined extension must stay behind the principal elevation and within the normal width, boundary and curtilage limits. rules.roof_rules: Where any part has more than one storey, the roof pitch should, as far as practicable, match the existing dwellinghouse. Roof terraces and balconies are not permitted development.
